designNotes.materialBlend: ScreenSpaceLightingApplyIndirectSpecular lerps the environment specular with the SSR radiance before EnvironmentBRDF; EnvironmentBRDFSpecular/FGD is therefore applied to the combined result exactly once.
designNotes.resultContract: RGBA16F un-premultiplied radiance with the blend weight in alpha. miss/off-screen/non-finite write weight 0 and keep the reflection probe.
designNotes.deferredSmoothness: SSR runs at event 206, before the GBuffer overwrites GBuffer2, so it reads the same 0.5 + 0.5 * smoothness encoding the Forward depth-normals prepass writes.
designNotes.colorHistoryFeedback: The color pyramid includes the previous frame's SSR contribution; intensity linearity is measured on the first SSR frame after a reset, which reads an SSR-free color history.
